title: An exact excursion Poisson budget controls feedback before a physical-clock classification

statement.quantifiers: The exact N227 five-reaction network, every fixed finite positive rate tuple, every axis a>=2; beta=k2/(k3+k4),q=k4/(k3+k4).
statement.assertion: Let g(b)=E_b pure-B pair deaths with birth beta*b and death b(b-1),g(0)=0. Then beta b Delta+g+b(b-1)Delta-2g=-b(b-1),g(1)=h(beta). In a complete actual excursion, E D_full=h+E sum_internalU[g(B+1)-g(B)] and E D1=q E D_full. Uniform full-event exponential tails imply exact axis drift E DeltaA=1-qh+O(1/a) and exponential increment moments; retaining independent axis waits Exp1/[k0+k1a(a-1)] permits a critical nonexplosion clock proof.
assumptions: All immigration, low-A activation, both death marks, self-return cycles and final event included.
Uniform full-event excursion tail proved before stopped Poisson summation; pure-B chain only computes an auxiliary potential.
Embedded choices use independent reaction uniforms and holding exponentials; coefficients time homogeneous.

inputs: Exact diagram and fixed positive rates, integrable auxiliary Poisson solution, uniform full-excursion tails.
outputs: Controlled O(1/a) full-feedback drift, critical boundary and positive-side clock ingredients with no frozen-A approximation.
interface.precision: Exact stochastic identity plus uniform asymptotics for fixed rate vector; no uniform onset over rates tending tozero.
costs: Computing gamma/plots or truncated-chain simulation is not an all-state theorem.
The physical clock is an additional proof obligation beyond recurrence/transience of the embedded chain.

proof_mechanism: Stopped Dynkin on x^b yields occupation generating ODE (1+x)F doubleprime-beta x F prime=1 with finite endpoint condition; incomplete gamma computes h.
Multiply pure-B Poisson identity by the actual common cubic propensity; only internal U adds a B correction, immigration contributes separately toA.
Predictable death mark probabilityq survives the final event; optional stopping paid by exponential full-event tails.
When A>=a/2, internal U probabilityO(1/a), immigrationO(1/a³); A<a/2 requires a long exponentially rare excursion.
Axis drift and independent waits include self-events; nonpositive drift admits localized log/quadratic Foster regularity, positive drift needs linear escape plus summable full physical time.
obstructions: A frozen fast subsystem alone does not give full-chain drift or equality.
Deleting immigration, low states or rare failed episodes can invalidate all-state explosion claims.
Changing rate order, dimension or reaction diagram requires new geometry, tails and clock estimates.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Find a complete-return Poisson potential, a legal all-direction geometry, uniform actual-event tails and an independent physical-clock comparison; retain equality and all-state accessibility rather than extrapolating a fast limit.

review.source_reported: Source fresh target-only derivation, exposed internal audits and finite diagnostics reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
